fields.label: Key
fields.description: Wire name, e.g. max_students or students. Travels verbatim in the push/usage payload.

fields.label: Icon
fields.description: Material icon name the console renders, e.g. people_outline.

fields.label: يُعرض في الأسعار
fields.description: Advertise this metric on the public pricing page. Not every metric is a selling point — Rased meters max_ai_tokens but has never listed it — and the storefront used to carry that editorial choice as a hardcoded list, which meant it could only ever describe one product.

fields.label: تسمية الأسعار
fields.description: Selling wording for the pricing page. The console needs a short column header — «التتبّع» — while the storefront is selling «التتبّع المباشر للمحصلين». Two different jobs for the same metric. Falls back to the label when empty.
